However, often the "Planner" is the one who draws the wrong conclusion from the data.

The Planner accepted the false premise provided by the WebSurfer.
Is the error in the WebSurfer (generating fake search results) or the Planner (interpreting them)?

Correct Answer: Jung Yun-ho.
